# Benefits of Outsourcing Local Delivery


Providing local, same-day delivery is one of the best ways to impress your customers and boost loyalty. Studies show that **68% of consumers shop more often when same-day delivery is available** , and **26% of shoppers abandon carts if local delivery isn’t an option** .


But while the rewards are significant, offering local delivery can be challenging for small businesses. Between managing in-house fleets, coordinating couriers, and handling logistical issues, it’s easy to see how the costs and time required can add up quickly. That’s where outsourcing your local delivery management to Getcho makes sense—it’s efficient, cost-effective, and stress-free.


## The Cost of Managing Local Deliveries In-House


Many small businesses hesitate to offer local delivery because of the resources it demands:


- **Labor Costs** : Assigning staff to coordinate orders, couriers, and customer updates can be time-intensive.
- **Fleet Maintenance** : Operating your own delivery vehicles adds expenses like labor, insurance, and maintenance.
- **Missed Deliveries** : Errors such as missed customer availability or unclear instructions can result in costly re-deliveries.


Without the right systems in place, managing local deliveries can feel overwhelming and expensive.


> Getcho tackles common delivery challenges with precision: verifying addresses and instructions to prevent costly errors like incorrect drop-offs, seamlessly managing sensitive requirements like ID verification for wine deliveries, and tracking every order in real time to resolve issues before they arise. With Getcho, your customers enjoy a smooth and reliable delivery experience every time.
